title: Timed Elastic Band (TEB)
text: Plan path to avoid obstacles and generate time-optimal trajectories, 16 inputs, 4 outputs; {Sample time (s)} sets the sample time of controller, {Specify lookahead time using input port} adds input port for lookahead time, {Lookahead time (s)}, {Specify goal tolerance using input port} adds input port for goal tolerance, {Goal tolerance ([m m rad])} sets the tolerance around goal pose, {Shape}, {Dimension ([m m])} sets the size of robot, {Fixed transform ([m m rad])} sets the transformation matrix, {Specify obstacle safety margin using input port} adds input port for obstacle safety margin, {Obstacle safety margin (m)} sets the safe distance between robot and obstacles, {Specify max velocity using input port} adds input port for maximum velocity, {Maximum velocity ([m/s rad/s])} sets the maximum limits of linear and angular velocity, {Specify max reverse velocity using input port} adds input port for maximum reverse, {Maximum reverse velocity (m/s)} sets the maximum velocity for reverse, {Specify max acceleration using input port} adds input port for maximum acceleration, {Maximum acceleration ([m/s^2 rad/s^2])} sets the maximum limits of linear and angular acceleration, {Specify min turning radius using input port} adds input port for minimum turning radius, {Minimum turning radius (m)} sets the minimum turning radius for vehicle on optimized, {Specify reference delta time using input port} adds input port for reference delta time, {Reference delta time (s)}, {Specify number of iterations using input port} adds input port for number of iterations, {Number of iterations}, {Specify time weight using input port} adds input port for time weight, {Time weight} sets the cost function weight for time, {Specify smoothness weight using input port} adds input port for smoothness weight, {Smoothness weight} sets the weight for smooth motion, {Specify obstacle weight using input port} adds input port for obstacle weight and {Obstacle weight} sets the weight for safe distance from obstacles. Values come from the instance.
